from typing import List, Any

def next_permutation(perm: List[Any]) -> List[Any]:
    """
    Find the lexicographically next permutation of the input list.
    
    Parameters:
        perm (List[Any]): The list to find the next permutation of.
        
    Returns:
        List[Any]: The next permutation of the input list.
    """
    # Find the rightmost element that is smaller than its successor
    i = len(perm) - 2
    while i >= 0 and perm[i] >= perm[i + 1]:
        i -= 1
    
    # If no such element exists, the list is sorted in descending order, return None
    if i == -1:
        return None
    
    # Find the smallest element greater than perm[i] to the right of i
    j = len(perm) - 1
    while perm[j] <= perm[i]:
        j -= 1
    
    # Swap perm[i] and perm[j]
    perm[i], perm[j] = perm[j], perm[i]
    
    # Reverse the sublist from i+1 to the end
    perm[i + 1:] = perm[i + 1:][::-1]
    
    return perm
